name: trama
description: See your System as a layered Model of state machines, review Proposals and Drifts, and steer your coding agent from one editor tab.

commands.title: Send to agent (closing the tab sends it too)

enumDescriptions: The editor's chat: Copilot in VS Code, Cursor in Cursor.
omp in the editor's integrated terminal.
Claude Code in the editor's integrated terminal.
trama.agent.markdownDescription: Agent used for every project and instruction: `chat` (the editor's chat; the default), `omp` or `claude` (in an integrated terminal). It applies only in your user settings.

enumDescriptions: A terminal tab beside the active editor.
trama.terminalLocation.markdownDescription: Where `omp` and Claude Code terminals open: `panel` (the terminal area; the default) or `editor` (a terminal tab beside the active editor). It applies only in your user settings.

trama.driftAutoPilot.markdownDescription: Automatically resolve Drift recommendations: `disabled` (manual, the default), `enabled` (recommends, approves and fixes non-critical Drifts) or `yolo` (also critical Drifts, the ones where your decision is urgently needed). It applies only in your user settings. After opening the editor, an explicit Resolve Drifts request or a finished scan is required before automatic collection resumes. A Task whose origin Drift is being fixed runs only after its fix Tasks are Done. A scan that failed or was interrupted counts as finished and does not suspend the delegation. It can run repeated cycles without an additional limit. Disabling stops new automatic steps but does not interrupt a Task already started.

trama.submitWhileRunning.markdownDescription: `disabled` (the default: Run, Run this design and Run all To do are unavailable while a run started by Trama is in progress) and `enabled` (a run can start while another one is in progress).

trama.analysis.markdownDescription: Model for design work: quick and written design requests, Resolve Drifts and import. Write the name as your agent accepts it: omp, Claude Code or Cursor's chat; for Copilot's chat, the name shown in the chat's model picker. Empty (the default) leaves the agent's default model. In Copilot the model also stays in the chat's picker. It only applies in your user settings.

trama.scan.markdownDescription: Model for scans: of the System, of Features and after an approval; it also applies to the sub-agents that compare Machines. Write the name as your agent accepts it: omp, Claude Code or Cursor's chat; for Copilot's chat, the name shown in the chat's model picker. Empty (the default) leaves the agent's default model. The chats' sub-agents get it with Update skills. It only applies in your user settings.

trama.execution.markdownDescription: Model for implementing Tasks: implement, implement all and implement a design, including the selective final scan of the run. Write the name as your agent accepts it: omp, Claude Code or Cursor's chat; for Copilot's chat, the name shown in the chat's model picker. Empty (the default) leaves the agent's default model. In Copilot the model also stays in the chat's picker. It only applies in your user settings.

trama.autoExit.markdownDescription: Close the agent's terminal as soon as the agent is idle or its command ends (default on). With it off, idle terminals stay open and every instruction still opens a new one. It only applies in your user settings.

trama.maxParallelAgents.markdownDescription: How many sub-agents the agent may run at once, in a scan, in the exploration of a design and in a run of Tasks (default 20; agents without sub-agents ignore it).

trama.autoScan.markdownDescription: After you approve a Proposal, launch the agent to scan the Features it touched. It applies to the chat or terminal agent.

trama.skillsDir.markdownDescription: Folder, relative to the project root, where **Trama: Initialize Project** installs the agent skills. Use `.claude/skills` for Claude Code.

trama.language.markdownDescription: Language the agent writes in, for example `Italian` or `Deutsch`. When set, every instruction Trama sends to the agent asks it to write everything it generates in that language, except code, which always stays in English. Empty (the default) asks nothing about language. It only reaches agents that Trama starts, changes nothing already written, and the Trama interface stays in English.
